name: Omniseo
summary: AI search visibility (GEO) tracking. Monitor and improve how your brand shows up in AI answers across ChatGPT, Google AI and other channels, tracking prompts, competitors and citations to grow AI-driven discovery.
best_for: brands and SEO teams that want to measure and improve how they show up in AI-generated answers (ChatGPT, Google AI and more) as AI search grows
skip_if: AI-driven traffic is still negligible for your business (classic SEO tools matter more), or you need concrete ranking control rather than visibility tracking
honest_knock: Two honest cautions. AI search visibility (GEO) is a young, fast-moving category. Tracking how you appear in ChatGPT and other AI answers is useful signal, but the metrics are far less standardized than classic SEO, and you're paying to monitor a moving target you only partly influence. And the step from Essentials to Professional is a big jump, mainly for prompts, lookups, seats and exports. Treat it as an early-mover intelligence tool, not a guaranteed ranking lever. Two smaller cautions from the pricing page itself, read on 20 October 2026. The trial covers two engines for seven days, so it cannot show you what the ten-engine paid plans report. And support is email-only on both self-serve plans; chat and phone start at Enterprise. The crawler analysis the site promotes works from server logs and crawl events, and the pricing table does not say which plan includes it.

pricing.entry_price_terms: per month (25 saved prompts, 5 seats, all 10 AI platforms)
pricing.notes: (re-verified 2026-11-16 by plain fetch of omniseo.com/pricing/; earlier readings 2026-08-17, 2026-09-28 and 2026-10-20) Four plans now. Starter $45/mo (25 saved prompts, 25 ad-hoc lookups, 5 competitors, 5 seats), Essentials $89/mo (50 saved prompts, 50 lookups, 5 competitors, 5 seats), Professional $349/mo (100 saved prompts, 200 lookups, 5 competitors, 10 seats, CSV and PDF exports of 5,000 rows a month) and Enterprise from $899/mo with custom terms and volume. Annual billing is $450, $890 and $3,490 a year, which the page describes as two months free. Every plan now monitors all 10 AI platforms (Google AI Overviews, AI Mode, ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Copilot, Claude, Meta AI, Grok and DeepSeek); until our 20 October 2026 reading Essentials covered four of them. There is a 7-day free trial with no credit card, covering ChatGPT and Google AI Overviews only, after which the first paid month is half price: $22.50, $44.50 or $174.50. The comparison table marks that first-month discount as not available on Enterprise.
